# Open Alzheimer's research resources, graded

A curated, skeptical list of open resources for modeling the brain and Alzheimer's disease. Grades come from the [2026-10 landscape review](../docs/landscape-2026-10/report.md) and are **not** endorsements: `our status` says what this project has actually checked. See [policy/VETTING.md](../policy/VETTING.md) for what each grade means.

## Disease progression models and benchmarks

### A: Good starting points

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [pySuStaIn (Subtype and Stage Inference)](https://github.com/ucl-pond/pySuStaIn) | MIT (license-file) | smoke-tested | Most-used open progression tool; atrophy subtypes replicated across cohorts. |
| [TADPOLE challenge (evaluation design)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2002.03419) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Strongest prospective, organiser-run AD forecasting benchmark; use its design, data is ADNI-gated. |

### B: Promising: vet and re-model first

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [BrLP (Brain Latent Progression, latent diffusion)](https://github.com/LemuelPuglisi/BrLP) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | MICCAI 2024 oral, but realistic generated MRI is not evidence of clinical validity. |
| [kde_ebm (kernel density event-based model)](https://github.com/ucl-pond/kde_ebm) | GPL-3.0 (license-file) | not-started | Maintained EBM variant; GPL so it must live in a separately licensed module. |
| [Leaspy / AD Course Map](https://github.com/aramis-lab/leaspy) | BSD-3-Clause-Clear (license-file) | not-started | Maintained mixed-effects trajectory models, but only independent test is a student thesis. |
| [pyebm](https://github.com/88vikram/pyebm) | GPL-3.0 (license-file) | not-started | Event-based model implementation; GPL-3.0 and unmaintained since 2022. |

### C: Avoid / red flag

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [DIVE, noxtoby/TADPOLE, ucl-pond/ebm (legacy repos)](https://github.com/ucl-pond) | mixed (api-metadata) | not-started | Archived, stale or unlicensed; use pySuStaIn or kde_ebm instead. |
| [GP progression model (Lorenzi)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2017.08.059) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | No maintained public repository could be confirmed. |
| [SuStaInMatlab](https://github.com/ucl-pond/SuStaInMatlab) | none (api-metadata) | not-started | No license (no reuse rights) and superseded by pySuStaIn. |

## Neuroimaging pipelines and imaging ML

### A: Good starting points

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Clinica (BIDS converters and pipelines)](https://github.com/aramis-lab/clinica) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | BIDS converters for ADNI, AIBL, OASIS and others; LICENSE.txt read 2026-10-18 is MIT (resolves notes conflict). |
| [ClinicaDL](https://github.com/aramis-lab/clinicadl) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | Built to prevent leakage (subject-level splits, leakage checks); peer-reviewed (CMPB 2022). |
| [FastSurfer](https://github.com/deep-MI/FastSurfer) | Apache-2.0 (license-file) | not-started | Peer-reviewed, containerised, maintained MRI segmentation. |
| [SynthSeg](https://github.com/BBillot/SynthSeg) | Apache-2.0 (license-file) | not-started | Contrast-agnostic segmentation, independently on par with FreeSurfer/FIRST for hippocampus. |

### B: Promising: vet and re-model first

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [BrainSegFounder](https://arxiv.org/html/2406.10395v3) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Code and weights exist but evaluated on tumour and stroke, not AD. |
| [Multimodal dementia etiology model (Xue/Kolachalama, Nat Med 2024)](https://github.com/vkola-lab/nmed2024) | AGPL-3.0 (license-file) | not-started | Externally validated, but AGPL, unclear weight availability, and a 2025 hotfix changed behaviour. |
| [SFCN brain-age model](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7610710/) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Low error on healthy UK Biobank does not show AD sensitivity; brain-age gap needs bias correction. |

### C: Avoid / red flag

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Any MRI AD-vs-CN classifier >95% or speech classifier >90%](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8604922/) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Presume leakage or confounding until shown otherwise (Wen 2020; Yagis 2021). |
| [BrainIAC (MRI foundation model)](https://github.com/AIM-KannLab/BrainIAC) | custom-noncommercial (docs) | not-started | Non-commercial weights on Dropbox; possible ADNI/OASIS overlap between pretraining and test sets. |
| [Kaggle / Hugging Face OASIS or ADNI slice datasets](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Unknown provenance, likely DUA breaches, and leakage-prone 2D slices. Banned in this repo. |
| [pyment brain-age models](https://github.com/estenhl/pyment-public) | CC-BY-NC-4.0 (license-file) | not-started | Non-commercial license blocks inclusion under an OSI license. |

## Brain simulators and whole-brain platforms

### A: Good starting points

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Allen Brain Modeling Toolkit (BMTK)](https://github.com/AllenInstitute/bmtk) | BSD-3-Clause (license-file) | not-started | Active, Allen-maintained multiscale network toolkit. |
| [Arbor](https://github.com/arbor-sim/arbor) | BSD-3-Clause (license-file) | not-started | Active multicompartment simulator. |
| [Brian2](https://github.com/brian-team/brian2) | CECILL-2.1 (license-file) | not-started | Mature, active spiking simulator; CeCILL is GPL-compatible copyleft. |
| [NEST simulator](https://github.com/nest/nest-simulator) | GPL-2.0-or-later (license-file) | not-started | Mature spiking-network simulator; isolate like TVB, check GPL-2.0 compatibility. |
| [NetPyNE](https://github.com/suny-downstate-medical-center/netpyne) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | Active network-building layer over NEURON. |
| [NEURON](https://github.com/neuronsimulator/nrn) | BSD-3-Clause (license-file) | not-started | Decades of independent use for cellular simulation; general-purpose, not AD-specific. |
| [The Virtual Brain (platform)](https://github.com/the-virtual-brain/tvb-root) | GPL-3.0-or-later (license-file) | not-started | Open whole-brain workhorse; copyleft, so it must sit in a separately GPL-licensed module. |

### B: Promising: vet and re-model first

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [MICrONS foundation model (cajal/fnn)](https://github.com/cajal/fnn) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | Peer-reviewed (Nature 2025) and MIT, but mouse visual cortex only; no AD relevance yet. |
| [neurolib](https://github.com/neurolib-dev/neurolib) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | Whole-brain modeling library with commits but no release since 2022; pin a commit. |
| [Open Brain Institute forks (BluePyOpt, neurodamus)](https://github.com/openbraininstitute) | LGPL-3.0 / Apache-2.0 (license-file) | not-started | Maintained heirs of archived Blue Brain code, with very small communities. |
| [TVB Alzheimer's virtual brains (Stefanovski 2019, Triebkorn 2022, Patow 2023)](https://frontiersin.org/journals/computational-neuroscience/articles/10.3389/fncom.2019.00054/full) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | One consortium, small ADNI subsets (classifier n=33, no external test); re-implement with nulls. |
| [VBI (Virtual Brain Inference)](https://pypi.org/project/vbi/) | Apache-2.0 (api-metadata) | not-started | Active inference add-on for TVB with a small user base; confirm its methods paper. |

### C: Avoid / red flag

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Archived BlueBrain/* repositories, CoreNEURON](https://www.github.com/BlueBrain) | mixed (api-metadata) | not-started | Read-only since Feb 2025; use NEURON and OBI forks instead. |
| [BrainLM (fMRI foundation model)](https://github.com/vandijklab/BrainLM) | CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (license-file) | not-started | No-derivatives license forbids distributing fine-tuned or modified versions. |
| [eBRAIN-Health Alzheimer's "digital twin" claims](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101058516) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Consortium communications only; revisit if peer-reviewed outcome validation appears. |
| [Fudan Digital Twin Brain / Fugaku mouse cortex](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.15745) | none (n/a) | not-started | Scale milestones with no public code or biological validation (DTB used ~0.72% of connections). |
| [Open Brain Institute hosted Virtual Labs](https://www.openbraininstitute.org/) | none-stated (docs) | not-started | Freemium, mouse-only, no open-source license stated; not a dependency for this repo. |
| [POYO, flywire_annotations](https://github.com/flyconnectome/flywire_annotations) | none (api-metadata) | not-started | No license file means no reuse rights. |
| [Virtual Aging Brain, EBRAINS-cosim, fast_tvb](https://repos.ecosyste.ms/api/v1/hosts/GitHub/repositories/ins-amu%2Fvirtual_aging_brain) | mixed (api-metadata) | not-started | Dormant since 2022-23; Virtual Aging Brain code may be incomplete. |

## Mechanistic and spreading models

### B: Promising: vet and re-model first

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Amyloid-beta oligomer ODE models](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC12334554/) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Theoretical, not calibrated to human data; audit for dependence on the retracted Abeta*56 work. |
| [ejcorn/tau-spread](https://github.com/ejcorn/tau-spread) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | MIT, but mouse data only and unmaintained since 2021. |
| [LCSB astrocyte energy-metabolism model](https://gitlab.lcsb.uni.lu/ICS-lcsb/energy-metabolism-model-astrocyte) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Peer-reviewed (PLoS Comp Biol 2023) but some experiments need Python 2.7 and FEniCS 1.5. |
| [Multiscale 19-variable AD ODE model](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC10995318/) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Sensitivity-analysed, but 75 parameters vs sparse human data is an identifiability risk; equations only. |
| [Nexis / extended network diffusion (UCSF Raj Lab)](https://github.com/Raj-Lab-UCSF/Nexis) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | Peer-reviewed method, but MATLAB-only, 2 stars and stale; port and benchmark. |
| [UCL network_spreading_models (NDM, FKPP, amyloid-weighted FKPP)](https://github.com/ucl-pond/network_spreading_models) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | Closest open toolbox to alzres.spreading, but evidence is a conference abstract with group-level fits. |

### C: Avoid / red flag

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [BioFINDER agent-based SIR tau spread model](https://github.com/DeMONLab-BioFINDER/Xiao_Tau_simulation_SIR) | none (license-file) | not-started | No LICENSE file (checked 2026-10-18), so no reuse rights; ask the authors to add one. |
| [Industry AD QSP models (Biogen/Applied BioMath, Certara, InSysBio)](https://www.certara.com/poster/quantitative-systems-pharmacology-model-for-therapies-targeting-a%ce%b2-and-tau-pathologies-in-alzheimers-disease/) | proprietary (docs) | not-started | Closed code and vendor-reported calibration; cannot be verified. |
| [Raj Lab Aggregation-Network-Diffusion](https://github.com/Raj-Lab-UCSF/Aggregation-Network-Diffusion) | none (api-metadata) | not-started | Dormant since 2020; README claims BSD-3 but no license file exists. |

## Datasets and cohorts

### A: Good starting points

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [OpenNeuro](https://openneuro.org/) | CC0-1.0 (docs) | not-started | Only clearly redistributable imaging source; no AD-specific accession confirmed yet. |
| [SEA-AD processed atlas (Allen Institute)](https://brain-map.org/explore/seattle-alzheimers-disease/seattle-alzheimers-disease-brain-cell-atlas-download) | Allen-Terms-of-Use (docs) | not-started | Only flagship AD cell atlas downloadable without an application; fetch at runtime, never re-host. |

### B: Promising: vet and re-model first

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [A4 / LEARN](https://ida.loni.usc.edu/collaboration/access/appApply.jsp?project=A4) | A4-DUA (docs) | not-started | Non-transferable licence; code only. |
| [AD Knowledge Portal (ROSMAP, Mayo, MSBB; AMP-AD)](https://adknowledgeportal.synapse.org/) | Synapse-DUC (docs) | not-started | Open tier plus controlled DUC; no redistribution of individual-level data in any form. |
| [ADNI (incl. TADPOLE data)](https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/) | ADNI-DUA (docs) | not-started | Backbone AD cohort; DUA forbids redistributing participant-level or derived data in any manner. |
| [ADSP / NIAGADS genetics](https://www.niagads.org/) | dbGaP-DUA (secondary) | not-started | Controlled via dbGaP or NIAGADS DSS; current application process unconfirmed. |
| [AIBL](https://data.aibl.org.au/adni/index.html) | AIBL-DUA (docs) | not-started | LONI application, non-commercial; code only in this repo. |
| [GNPC v1 proteomics (via AD Workbench)](https://www.alzheimersdata.org/gnpc-v1-harmonized-dataset) | ADDI-terms (docs) | not-started | Workspace-only access; SomaScan and Olink agree poorly (median r ~0.30). |
| [HCP-Aging](https://humanconnectome.org/study/hcp-lifespan-aging/data-use-terms) | NDA-DUC (docs) | not-started | Needs NDA DUC with an institutional signatory; use open-tier HCP connectomes as templates. |
| [NACC](https://naccdata.org/requesting-data/data-request-process) | NACC-DUA (docs) | not-started | Free request plus DUA, 56,000+ participants; stratify by ADRC and UDS version. |
| [OASIS-1/2/3/4](https://sites.wustl.edu/oasisbrains/) | OASIS-DUA (docs) | not-started | Despite the name, DUA-gated and non-commercial; no face-reconstructable derivatives. |
| [UK Biobank](https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/use-our-data/fees/) | UKB-MTA (docs) | not-started | Fees GBP 3,000-9,000; analysis only inside the Research Analysis Platform. |

## Targets, drugs, knowledge graphs and agents

### A: Good starting points

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Open Targets Platform](https://platform.opentargets.org/) | CC0-1.0 (to confirm) (secondary) | not-started | Free, open-source target prioritisation with per-source evidence; do not rely on literature score alone. |

### B: Promising: vet and re-model first

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Agora (AMP-AD target explorer)](https://agora.adknowledgeportal.org/) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | More than 950 nominated targets, but nominations are hypotheses from consortia that study them. |
| [Alzforum Therapeutics database and Cummings pipeline reviews](https://alzforum.org/therapeutics) | editorial (docs) | not-started | Reliable as a census, not as efficacy evidence (2025 pipeline still listed simufilam). |
| [AlzKB knowledge graph](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC11066745/) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Literature-derived edges need retraction filtering and version pinning (sizes drift by version). |
| [AlzPED (preclinical efficacy database)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC11713837/) | unknown (secondary) | not-started | Useful for meta-research; only 4% of studies report power calculations, 10% blinding. |
| [ESCARGOT, base Biomni (LLM research agents)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12326721/) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | No independent benchmark; non-deterministic; possible answer leakage via pretraining data. |
| [PrimeKG and TxGNN](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9893183/) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Open graph and zero-shot repurposing model; validation is retrospective only. |
| [TREAT-AD probes and Target Enabling Packages](https://treatad.org/) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Openly distributed chemical/biological probes; terms of reuse not confirmed. |

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |

## Foundation models and biomarker models

### B: Promising: vet and re-model first

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [BioFINDER plasma p-tau to amyloid-PET models](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC12808103/) | none-released (n/a) | not-started | R^2 0.73-0.79 but assay- and cohort-specific with no code; re-implement from the paper. |
| [Boltz-2, OpenFold3, Chai-1](https://huggingface.co/OpenFold/OpenFold3) | MIT / Apache-2.0 / disputed (secondary) | not-started | Commercially usable AF3 alternatives, unvalidated on AD targets; tau and Abeta are disordered (hard case). |
| [Evo 2](https://github.com/ArcInstitute/evo2) | Apache-2.0 (code) (license-file) | not-started | Code LICENSE is Apache-2.0; weights license still ambiguous (possibly NVIDIA Open Model License). |
| [Geneformer](https://huggingface.co/ctheodoris/Geneformer) | Apache-2.0 (docs) | not-started | Openly licensed, but zero-shot use often loses to PCA/HVG baselines; AD perturbation work is preprint-only. |
| [scGPT (incl. brain checkpoint)](https://github.com/bowang-lab/scGPT) | MIT (license-file) | not-started | Did not beat simple linear baselines on perturbation prediction (Nature Methods 2025). |
| [Synthetic AD trial generator (medRxiv 2024), LDM100K](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.02.05.24302140.full.pdf) | unknown (unconfirmed) | not-started | Precedents for shareable demo data; licenses, memorisation risk and fidelity unverified. |
| [UKB Dementia Risk Score](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9519470) | none-released (n/a) | not-started | Externally validated (AUC 0.83 in Whitehall II); re-implement from published coefficients. |

### C: Avoid / red flag

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ADReSS / DementiaBank speech classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.07410) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Silence-only segments give ~100% accuracy (recording confound); tiny test sets. |
| [AlphaFold 3 weights, AlphaGenome, ESM3-open](https://deepmind.google.com/science/alphagenome/terms) | custom-restrictive (docs) | not-started | Restrictive terms (AlphaGenome bars commercial use and training other models). |
| [Keystroke and small digital-biomarker claims (e.g. Neurokeys 97.9%)](https://jmir.org/2024/1/e59247/PDF) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | n=111, unreplicated, implausibly high sensitivity. |

## Integrity watchlist

### C: Avoid / red flag

| Resource | License | Our status | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Bredesen ReCODE "reversal" claims](https://alzheimer.ca/en/whats-happening/news/bredesen-protocol-offers-false-hope-reversing-alzheimers-disease) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Uncontrolled case series with no published RCT; Alzheimer Society of Canada calls it "false hope". |
| [Eliezer Masliah-authored findings](https://alzforum.org/news/community-news/data-fabrication-ousted-nia-neuroscience-director-eliezer-masliah) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | NIH research-misconduct finding (Sept 2024); a Science dossier flagged 132 papers. |
| [Lesne et al. 2006 (Nature) Abeta*56 oligomer and work built on it](https://researchexperts.utmb.edu/en/publications/retraction-note-a-specific-amyloid-%CE%B2-protein-assembly-in-the-brai/) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Retracted 2024 for image manipulation; other labs doubt Abeta*56 is detectable as described. |
| [Simufilam / Cassava Sciences data](https://sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2024-151) | n/a (n/a) | not-started | Two failed Phase 3 trials, $40M SEC settlement, indicted academic collaborator (Hoau-Yan Wang). |
